title: Secondary Forest Brazil — YbYrá-BR v8.1 (from MapBiomas Collection 10.1, 1986–2024)
description:
Annual maps of secondary forest dynamics for Brazil (1986–2024), derived from 
MapBiomas Collection 10.1 land-use and land-cover data using Google Earth Engine.

Producer: YBYRÁ-BR Project 
Funding: CNPq (Process 401741/2023-0)
License: CC-BY-4.0

Please cite:
Silva Junior et al. (2020). Benchmark maps of 33 years of secondary forest age 
for Brazil. Scientific Data. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-020-00600-4
